headline: La respuesta energética a la guerra en Irán podría reducir la demanda de crudo: AIE
summary: The IEA said the Middle East conflict caused the largest disruption in history to global oil and gas trade. It estimates world crude demand could fall by more than 4% by 2035 if governments accelerate electrification, efficiency and fuel substitution.
why: The International Energy Agency advises major oil-consuming countries on energy policy and publishes global energy outlooks. Its demand projections shape long-term views on oil prices and energy investment.
